field.label: Administrator and SSH logins
field.help: Notify about successful and unsuccessful administrator logins reported by the web interface or SSH service. Passwords are not included.

field.label: CrowdSec security and errors
field.help: Notify when CrowdSec logs a blocking decision or a processing or service error. Security decisions and service faults are identified separately.

field.label: Firewall block summaries
field.help: Group logged firewall blocks into a summary when at least ten blocked packets are recorded within five minutes. Individual packets are not sent.

field.label: IDS/IPS security alerts
field.help: Notify about high-severity Suricata alerts written to its EVE JSON log. Requires IDS/IPS logging.

field.label: Certificate expiry alerts
field.help: Check the certificate used by the OPNsense web interface. Warn at 30, 7, 1 and 0 days remaining. Does not transmit certificates or keys.

field.label: Check other stored certificates
field.help: Also check all locally stored certificates, including inactive ones. Some old or unused certificates may intentionally be expired.
